newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil products firm a little, except gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil products firm a little, except gasoline.

text.p: NWE Oil products, except gasoline, were firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline was slightly softer and Eurograde barges traded in the range $198-$202 a tonne fob ARA.
Naphtha was slightly firmer on the back of crude oil futures and June swaps were talked at around $183 a tonne cif NWE.
Gas oil firmed as benchmark IPE futures recovered some of Thursday's losses. The barge market was dead with premiums seen at June IPE +50 cents/+$1.0 a tonne fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel barges hit two-month highs at $87/$88 a tonne on short covering and thin supply. Cargoes were helped by material leaking out of the region.
